tei:div.tei:p: The first seliḥah for the seventeenth of Tammuz in the Ashkenazi rites, translated to German by Isaac Seligman Baer in 1865. First transcribed from the Fraktur and orthographically modernized in 2025 for a European Academy for Jewish Liturgy retreat. Thank you to the great David Schapiro for his extensive help in the process!

This is a transcription of “Atanu l’Kha Yotsér,” a seliḥah for the 17th of Tammuz of unknown authorship found in 13th century Ashkenazi manuscripts and translated by Isaac Seligman Baer in הסליחות לכל השנה: לפי מנהג האשכנזים Ha-Seliḥot le-khol ha-shanah: le-fi minhag ha-Ashkenazim (1865), pp. 558-561.
